_comment: Copy this file to config.json (which is gitignored) and fill in your own values. config.json is the single source of all instance-specific config — token, org, channels, users, watch list, repos. IDs are Slack channel/user IDs (C… / U…). See README.md for how to obtain each.

team-general.for: DEFAULT. Anything without a clear feature home. Use when in doubt.

feature-x.for: Work on feature X in any repo.

repos.name: your-repo
repos.for: what this repo is, so the classifier can route an issue to it
